A heated political debate on Armenian television took a dramatic turn when a pro-government analyst and an opposition journalist went from trading arguments to trading blows! The clash reportedly erupted after a war of words over the opposition's political agenda spiralled into personal insults, eventually turning the studio into a boxing ring.
